title: theme.json
description: The desk's appearance contract. Read by the Quickshell Theme singleton, by the Hyprland opacity rules, and by ,theme.sh apply — three readers, so a shape change needs a check that is not any one of them.

palette.description: The active palette. Must name a table in Theme.qml.

mode.description: auto follows the sun timer; manual pins `palette` until it is handed back.

scale.description: UI scale. Bounds match the IPC clamp, so the file cannot hold a value the shell would refuse.

opacity.description: Global window-opacity dial. 1 is fully opaque.

wallpaper.description: Absolute path, or "" to let the palette decide.

cheatsheet_linger_ms.description: How long the passive cheatsheet stays after you leave a submap.
